review_note: Reviewed 2026-10-25. HCSSH + H product exit: retain the H SOMO, natural 21, as formal CAS(1,1). Both tested CAS(3,2) occupied-donor choices give the same endpoint energies and exactly 2/1 occupations at reported precision; no need for either occupied donor as an active orbital was established. CAS(1,1) is a compact production model choice from those single-configuration data, not a separately completed CAS(1,1) or correlated-potential validation. The filled donor stays inactive and optimized. This endpoint has its own H identity and geometry. Selected from native occupations and AO coefficients, not an energy-window rule. These fixed-geometry CASSCF screens select a production model; they do not establish quantitative CASPT2-F12, angular or asymptotic-plateau convergence. Preserve production orbital, root and connectivity checks. State averaging is optimization support; only D1 contributes reactive flux. Direct CASPT2-F12 uses avdz-f12/avtz-f12 CBS power 3.7 and the separate 30 angstrom asymptote. Outer dividing surfaces use fragment COM separation; the correction scan uses the mapped interfragment anchor of the saved product complex. Preserve both explicitly configured grids and the product-side geometry.

states.energy_reference_note: One ground-parent adiabatic doublet path D1 relative to its spin-free ground-fragment asymptote. Other state-averaged roots support orbitals; they are not extra reactive flux.
